rules.content:
title: DaaS Platform Transaction Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detect cryptocurrency transactions matching Deepfake-as-a-Service (DaaS) subscription patterns: recurring payments of $100-$1,000/month to wallets associated with known deepfake service providers, or 
logsource:
    product: crypto
    category: blockchain_analytics
    service: blockchain_analytics
detection:
    selection_recurring:
        payment_type: "recurring"
        recurring_payment_amount|gte: 100
        recurring_payment_amount|lte: 1000
        recurring_payment_currency: "USD"
        recurring_payment_interval: "monthly"
        destination_wallet_flag|contains:
            - "deepfake_service"
            - "daas_provider"
    selection_onetime:
        payment_type: "one-time"
        transaction_amount|gte: 50
        transaction_amount|lte: 500
        destination_wallet_flag|contains:
            - "deepfake_service"
            - "daas_provider"
    condition: selection_recurring or selection_onetime
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0115: DaaS Platform Transaction Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview")`
`comment("Native query required - audio/video analysis cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_collaboration sourcetype=flame:video_conferencing
(camera_driver_name="*OBS Virtual*" OR camera_driver_name="*ManyCam*" OR camera_driver_name="*DeepFace*" OR camera_driver_name="*FaceSwap*")
OR audio_analysis_score>0.75
OR lip_sync_delta_ms>200
| eval risk_score=case(
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%DeepFace%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%FaceSwap%", 90,
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%OBS Virtual%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%ManyCam%", 50,
    audio_analysis_score>0.75, 80,
    lip_sync_delta_ms>200, 70)
| where risk_score>=50
| stats count values(camera_driver_name) as cameras values(audio_analysis_score) as audio_scores max(lip_sync_delta_ms) as max_lip_delta by user_id session_id
rules.title: DL-0116: Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview (SPLUNK)
